title: Messages
inboxIntro: Private conversations, groups and the chat rooms of your events and cities.
requestsHint: People you do not know yet. They can send only a few messages until you accept.
noConversations: No conversations yet. Open a profile and press “Message”, or join the chat of an event you are going to.
hiddenMessage: This message was hidden by a moderator.
unreadCount: {count, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}}
status_polling: Live updates are unavailable; checking for new messages every few seconds.
skippedInvites: {count, plural, one {The group was created, but # person could not be invited.} other {The group was created, but # people could not be invited.}}
groupHandlesHint: Handles separated by spaces or commas, for example anna, swing-school. You can invite more people later.
signInToMessage: Sign in to send a message
signInToChat: Sign in to open the chat
eventChatHint: For organizers and everyone who is going or interested.
requestBanner: {name} wants to message you. Accept to reply, decline to remove the request, or block to stop any further contact. They are not told what you choose.
groupRequestBanner: You were invited to the group “{title}”. Accept to join the conversation or decline to remove the invitation.
readOnlyRoom: This chat is read-only because the event is not published any more.
blockedBanner: You blocked this person. Neither of you can send messages here.
requestPending: {count, plural, one {{name} has not accepted your request yet. You can send # more message until they do.} other {{name} has not accepted your request yet. You can send # more messages until they do.}}
requestLimitReached: {name} has not accepted your request yet. You can write again once they do.
composerHint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line
charsLeft: {count, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}
attachmentReady: Attached: {name}. It will be sent with your message.
blockedSenderMessage: A message from someone you blocked.
schoolBanner: You are writing here as {school}. Members see the school as the sender; your name is recorded for the school’s administrators only.
sentBySchool: sent on behalf of the school
schoolConversationsHint: Chats of the schools you manage. You read and write there as the school.
error_GENERIC: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error_SERVER_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
error_FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
error_VERIFY_EMAIL: Confirm your email address to use messages.
error_BANNED: Your account is suspended, so messages are unavailable.
error_PROFILE_REQUIRED: Create your profile first: messages are sent from a profile.
error_INVALID_INPUT: Check the text: a message needs 1 to 2000 characters.
error_NOT_FOUND: This conversation does not exist or you are not a member of it.
error_RATE_LIMITED: You are sending too fast. Wait a moment and try again.
error_CHAT_UNAVAILABLE: Messages cannot be sent in this conversation.
error_REQUEST_LIMIT: You have reached the limit of messages before the request is accepted.
error_ROOM_NOT_ELIGIBLE: The event chat is open to organizers and to people who are going or interested. Respond to the event first.
error_ALREADY_MEMBER: This person is already in the group or has been invited.
error_GROUP_FULL: The group has reached its member limit.
error_ATTACHMENT_NOT_ALLOWED: Photos can be sent after the other person accepts your request.
error_EDIT_WINDOW_CLOSED: A message can be edited for 15 minutes after sending. You can still delete it.
error_EDIT_UNAVAILABLE: This message can no longer be edited.
